message: Last summer, we had a storm that knocked out the power for hours, and wouldn’t you know it, my phone died right as I was looking for the latest updates. I learned the hard way that it’s always good to have a plan in place before the winds start howling. The folks at Ready.gov have some handy tips on preparing for hurricanes and other storms—think of it as a cozy little insurance policy for those unexpected moments. Have you ever been caught off guard by a storm? 🌪️
